rows.notes: Native static-triangle normal/tangent CPU comparisons: 48 compiled graphs, 398 typed programs, 10704 evaluations and ten explicit rejections. Native-generated UV frames, transforms/instances, base/convention/strength, radial axes and analytic derivatives are tested. Graphs, selected nonzero derivatives and full image-normal-mapped render replay on four GPUs. Full bump state, motion/other geometry, degenerate plain-tangent nonfinite behavior, original asset materials and all native hosts remain open; strict differences persist.

Eight resident storage formats and five native alpha modes are exercised through PNG/JPEG/OpenEXR ImageManager file loading with five color selections. Linux runs 450 parameter variants, independent known lossless texels and queued replacement/lifetime checks. A final 116352-sample corpus passes four-GPU replay; Android file decoding and lifecycle are not proven. Earlier resident synthetic sampling includes four filters/extensions. TIFF/LZW and other format paths, production OCIO/cache/animation stress and all native platform hosts remain required.
